question: Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Peer comp, each company's own fiscal quarter ending Apr 1-Jul 31, 2026 (GAAP):
| Row | Revenue | YoY revenue growth | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-30) | 5,463.0 | 22.82% | 61.36% | 42.28% |
| Analog Devices (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-05-02) | 3,623.5 | 37.25% | 67.33% | 38.08% |
| Microchip Technology (Q1 FY2027, ended 2026-06-30) | 1,484.7 | 38.05% | 63.24% | 22.68% |
| NXP Semiconductors (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-28) | 3,496.0 | 19.48% | 57.27% | 30.64% |

output.answer:
# Peer Comp Table — Analog & Mixed-Signal Semiconductors

**Alignment:** Each company's own fiscal quarter ended within April 1 – July 31, 2026. No calendarization applied. All figures are GAAP, per SEC filings (10-Q/8-K earnings releases) as of October 3, 2026.

| Company | Fiscal Quarter Label | Quarter-End Date | Revenue (USD M) | YoY Rev. Growth | Gross Margin | Operating Margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments | Q2 2026 | Jun 30, 2026 | $5,463 | +22.8% | 61.4% | 42.3% |
| Analog Devices | Fiscal Q2 2026 | May 2, 2026 | $3,623 | +37.2% | 67.3% | 38.1% |
| Microchip Technology | Fiscal Q1 2027 | Jun 30, 2026 | $1,485 | +38.0% | 63.2% | 22.7% |
| NXP Semiconductors | Q2 2026 | Jun 28, 2026 | $3,496 | +19.5% | 57.3% | 30.6% |

## Supporting detail (GAAP)

**Texas Instruments — Q2 2026 (ended 6/30/26)**
- Revenue $5,463M vs. $4,448M in Q2 2025 → +22.8%
- Gross profit $3,352M → 61.4% of revenue
- Operating income $2,310M → 42.3% of revenue

**Analog Devices — Fiscal Q2 2026 (ended 5/2/26)**
- Revenue $3,623M vs. $2,640M in FQ2 2025 → +37.2%
- Gross margin $2,440M → 67.3% of revenue
- Operating income $1,380M → 38.1% of revenue

**Microchip Technology — Fiscal Q1 2027 (ended 6/30/26)**
- Net sales $1,484.7M vs. $1,075.5M in FQ1 2026 → +38.0%
- Gross profit $938.9M → 63.2% of net sales
- Operating income $336.8M → 22.7% of net sales

**NXP Semiconductors — Q2 2026 (ended 6/28/26)**
- Revenue $3,496M vs. $2,926M in Q2 2025 → +19.5%
- GAAP gross profit $2,002M → 57.3% of revenue
- GAAP operating income $1,071M → 30.6% of revenue

## Notes
- **No calendarization was required:** all four companies had exactly one fiscal quarter ending in the window, and none overlap the same calendar quarter-end, so the "own fiscal quarter" rule is satisfied without adjustment.
- Margins are computed as reported (gross profit / revenue; GAAP operating income / revenue), consistent with the definitions requested — note these are **GAAP** operating margins, which for ADI (38.1% vs. ~49.0% adjusted) and Microchip (22.7% vs. ~35.1% non-GAAP) differ materially from the non-GAAP figures those companies headline.
- Microchip's quarter (June 30, 2026) is a **fiscal-year-2027** first quarter; its label reflects that (fiscal year ends March).

**Sources**
- TI 8-K (Jul. 22, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97476/000009747626000148/txn-20260722.htm
- ADI press release / 8-K exhibit (May 20, 2026): https://investor.analog.com/news-releases/news-release-details/analog-devices-reports-record-fiscal-second-quarter-2026
- Microchip Q1 FY2027 press release: https://ir.microchip.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1409/microchip-technology-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-of-fiscal-year-2027
- NXP Q2 2026 press release (Jul. 28, 2026): https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-second-quarter-2026-results

One caution: the TI and NXP quarter-end dates and the Analog Devices quarter-end are drawn from press-release/10-Q summaries; I could not open the raw 10-Q balance-sheet pages directly. The revenue, gross profit, and operating income figures are corroborated across multiple independent summaries and the SEC 8-K filings, but if you need the exact period-end dates verified to the day, those should be confirmed against each company's 10-Q cover page.
